name: tell-tail
description: Local tool-call observability for Codex Desktop on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: See tool calls across your Codex plugins
interface.longDescription: Set up persistent local tracing, inspect observed plugin calls, and diagnose capture health. Requires macOS and a one-time Codex restart. Captures exported result metadata; history is in memory.
defaultPrompt: Set up Tell-Tail tracing for my Codex plugins.
Check Tell-Tail capture health and open the dashboard.
